title_en: People's Government of Yexie Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai v. Jiang Rongxiang et al. — dispute over liability for water pollution
ruling_gist_en: China adopts the principle of polluter liability in the prevention and control of environmental pollution by hazardous wastes. Producers, sellers, importers, and users of products shall bear the responsibility for pollution prevention and control of the hazardous wastes they generate, and shall report to the competent environmental protection authority the types, quantities, flow directions, storage, and disposal of hazardous wastes, and shall, in accordance with state regulations, entrust the treatment to entities with corresponding qualifications for hazardous waste treatment. Where a hazardous waste generator fails to declare the specific circumstances of hazardous wastes in accordance with the law and unauthorizedly entrusts a unit or individual without the qualifications for hazardous waste treatment to treat hazardous wastes, such conduct constitutes a violation of pollution prevention responsibilities. If the above illegal acts cause environmental pollution accidents, the hazardous waste generator has reckless intent regarding the occurrence of the relevant damage results, and cannot be exempted from legal liability on the grounds that it is not the direct environmental pollution tortfeasor. Moreover, since the unauthorized entrustment by the hazardous waste generator is a necessary condition for the environmental pollution accident, it shall bear joint and several liability with the actual hazardous waste treatment entity. Where there are multiple generators, liability may be apportioned based on factors such as the respective amounts of illegally treated hazardous waste and their roles in causing the accident.
keywords_en: Civil; water pollution liability dispute; first instance; basic people's court; Shanghai; state organ; natural person; legal person; Tort Liability Law; Environmental Protection Law; liability of hazardous waste generator; determination of joint and several liability; compensation for pollution treatment costs; supporting plaintiff; industrial waste acid dumping; river pollution; entrusting hazardous waste treatment to unqualified entities; polluter bears responsibility according to law; water pollution liability dispute against Jiang Rongxiang et al.
full_text_en:
Songjiang District Ye Xie Town People's Government of Shanghai v. Jiang Rongxiang et al. — dispute over liability for water pollution

Ruling Summary

China adopts the principle that the polluter shall be held responsible according to law for the prevention and control of environmental pollution by hazardous waste. Producers, sellers, importers, and users of products shall, in accordance with the law, assume the responsibility for the prevention and control of pollution caused by hazardous waste generated by them, and shall report to the competent environmental protection authority on the types, quantities, flow, storage, and disposal of the hazardous waste, and shall also, as prescribed by the state, deliver such waste to a unit qualified to handle hazardous waste for treatment. Where a hazardous waste generator fails to report the specific information on the hazardous waste in accordance with the law and arbitrarily entrusts a unit or individual not qualified to handle hazardous waste with its treatment, such act constitutes a violation of the pollution prevention and control responsibility. If an environmental pollution accident is caused by the above illegal act, the hazardous waste generator is willfully indifferent to the occurrence of the relevant damage and cannot be exempted from legal liability on the ground that it is not the direct environmental pollution tortfeasor. Moreover, since the arbitrary entrustment by the hazardous waste generator is a necessary condition for the environmental pollution accident, it shall bear joint and several liability with the actual handler of the hazardous waste. Where multiple generators are involved, liability may be apportioned based on factors such as the respective amounts of hazardous waste illegally treated and the roles played in the accident.

Plaintiff: Songjiang District Ye Xie Town People's Government of Shanghai, domiciled at No. 1 Ye Xie Town Government Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

Defendant: Jiang Rongxiang, male, 58 years old, domiciled at Room 203, No. 33, Lane 200, Binchuan Road, Minhang District, Shanghai, currently serving a sentence at Wujiaochang Prison, Shanghai.

Defendant: Dong Shengzhen, male, 28 years old, domiciled at No. 132, Dongnali Village, Daimiao Township, Dongping County, Shandong Province, currently serving a sentence at Songjiang District Detention Center, Shanghai.

Defendant: Shanghai Jiayu Chemical Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 7806-1, Hunan Highway, Xinchang Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

Defendant: Haomeng Vehicle Parts (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 8553, Chuannanfeng Highway, Situan Town, Fengxian District, Shanghai.

Defendant: Shanghai Rixin Hot-Dip Galvanizing Co., Ltd., domiciled at Fengtai Economic Development Zone, Taizhen Town, Fengxian District, Shanghai.

The plaintiff, Songjiang District Ye Xie Town People's Government of Shanghai (hereinafter referred to as Ye Xie Town Government), filed a lawsuit with the court against the defendants Jiang Rongxiang, Dong Shengzhen, Shanghai Jiayu Chemical Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jiayu Company), Haomeng Vehicle Parts (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Haomeng Company), and Shanghai Rixin Hot-Dip Galvanizing Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Rixin Company) regarding a dispute over liability for water pollution.

The plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government alleged: In February 2011, the plaintiff discovered that the water quality, soil, and vegetation around the Hongxian River in Ye Xie Town were severely polluted, with the river water having an unusual odor and turning yellow, small animals near the riverbank dying for no reason, and the ecological environment being damaged. On the evening of March 27, 2011, the Ye Xie Town Police Station discovered that the defendant Dong Shengzhen was discharging industrial waste acid from a tank truck bearing license plate number Yu P28879 into a rainwater well 100 meters south of the Hongxian River, and arrested Dong Shengzhen. Investigation by the public security authorities revealed that between February and March 2011, the defendant Jiang Rongxiang directed his driver Dong Shengzhen to dump six truckloads of waste acid collected from the defendants Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company into the Hongxian River in Ye Xie Town, causing serious pollution to the Hongxian River. Consequently, Jiang Rongxiang and Dong Shengzhen were sentenced to two years and one year and three months of fixed-term imprisonment, respectively. Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company were each fined RMB 460,000, RMB 160,000, and RMB 160,000 by the Shanghai Environmental Protection Bureau.

After the pollution accident, to promptly and properly dispose of various pollutants, avoid secondary pollution, and restore the river's original functions and ecology, the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government allocated funds and entrusted the Ye Xie Town Water Management Department to carry out remediation of the polluted river. After the remediation project was completed, it was confirmed through price evaluation that the plaintiff actually incurred a total expenditure of RMB 887,266 for the remediation of the river pollution.

In summary, the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government argued that the defendants Jiang Rongxiang and Dong Shengzhen illegally dumped industrial waste acid into the Hongxian River, causing the pollution accident, and should be liable for the economic losses incurred by the plaintiff as a result. The defendants Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company violated relevant legal provisions by providing or entrusting hazardous waste to Jiang Rongxiang, who lacked an operating license, for disposal, and should bear joint and several compensatory liability according to law. Therefore, the plaintiff sought a judgment ordering Jiang Rongxiang, Dong Shengzhen, Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company to jointly and severally compensate the plaintiff for economic losses of RMB 887,266 incurred in remediating the Hongxian River pollution and lawyer fees of RMB 74,981, totaling RMB 962,247.

The defendant Jiang Rongxiang argued: The defendant Dong Shengzhen was his employed driver, and Dong Shengzhen dumped the waste acid at the location designated by him. He bore some responsibility for the pollution accident and should be liable for compensation for the losses incurred by the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government, but he actually had no financial capacity to compensate.

The defendant Dong Shengzhen argued: He was a driver employed by the defendant Jiang Rongxiang, and the six truckloads of waste acid collected from the defendants Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company were dumped into the rainwater well 100 meters south of the Hongxian River as instructed by Jiang Rongxiang. He requested the court to handle the dispute in accordance with the law.

The defendant Jiayu Company argued: It had a hydrochloric acid purchase and sale relationship with the defendant Jiang Rongxiang. Jiang Rongxiang claimed that a unit needed waste acid, so it entrusted its company's waste acid to Jiang Rongxiang for disposal. It was neither aware of nor able to control Jiang Rongxiang's actual act of arbitrarily dumping the waste acid, and it did not directly participate in the dumping, so it should not bear compensatory liability.

The defendant Haomeng Company argued: 1. From the perspective of the litigation subject, the manager of the river should be the water affairs department, so the Ye Xie Town Government's filing of the lawsuit as the plaintiff was improper; moreover, the criminal judgment had already identified the polluters as the defendants Jiang Rongxiang and Dong Shengzhen, so others should not be named as defendants. 2. From the substantive perspective, it had a hydrochloric acid purchase and sale relationship with the defendant Jiayu Company, and Jiayu Company simultaneously undertook to handle the waste acid; at that time, Jiayu Company also provided it with the hazardous waste operating license of Shanghai Pudong Jiefang Chemical Plant, so its agreement to deliver the waste acid to Jiayu Company for disposal was not improper; the fact that Jiayu Company actually delivered the waste acid to Jiang Rongxiang for disposal was unrelated to it, so it should not bear compensatory liability.

The defendant Rixin Company argued: It had no direct relationship with the defendants Jiang Rongxiang and Dong Shengzhen; it had a hydrochloric acid purchase and sale relationship with the defendant Jiayu Company, and Jiayu Company simultaneously repurchased the waste acid generated from its production. How Jiayu Company disposed of the waste acid was unrelated to it, so it should not bear compensatory liability.

To prove its claims, the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government submitted the following evidence to the court:

1. The criminal judgment (2011) Song Xing Chu Zi No. 1222 of the Songjiang District People's Court of Shanghai, proving that the defendant Jiang Rongxiang directed the defendant Dong Shengzhen to dump waste acid transported from the defendants Haomeng Company, Jiayu Company, and Rixin Company into the rainwater well of the Hongxian River within the plaintiff's territory;

2. Three administrative penalty decisions of the Shanghai Environmental Protection Bureau, proving that after the pollution accident, the defendants Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company were each administratively fined by the Shanghai Environmental Protection Bureau;

3. Interrogation records of the defendants Jiang Rongxiang and Dong Shengzhen by the public security authorities, proving that the defendants Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company delivered waste acid to Jiang Rongxiang for disposal, and also proving that between February and March 2011, Dong Shengzhen, under the direction of Jiang Rongxiang, dumped six truckloads of waste acid into the rainwater well within the plaintiff's territory that flowed into the Hongxian River, including four truckloads from Haomeng Company, one truckload from Rixin Company, and one truckload from Jiayu Company;

4. Records of inquiries by the public security authorities with staff of the defendants Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company, proving that the above defendants were all aware that neither Jiayu Company nor Jiang Rongxiang possessed a hazardous waste operating license;

5. The river remediation project contract, sewer sludge cleaning contract, project supervision contract, consulting contract, construction compensation contract, remediation project price evaluation report, payment vouchers, and invoices, proving that the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government actually incurred economic losses of RMB 887,266 in remediating the pollution accident;

6. Advance appropriation vouchers, payment vouchers, and invoices, proving that the costs of pollution remediation were paid by the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government through fiscal appropriations to the Ye Xie Water Affairs Station;

7. The lawyer engagement contract and lawyer fee invoice, proving that the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government paid lawyer fees of RMB 74,981.

The defendants Jiang Rongxiang, Dong Shengzhen, and Jiayu Company had no objection to the authenticity of the above evidence provided by the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government and requested the court to review it in accordance with the law.

The defendant Haomeng Company had no objection to the authenticity of the above evidence provided by the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government but argued that evidence 1-4 further demonstrated that the pollution accident was committed by the defendants Jiang Rongxiang and Dong Shengzhen, and that its company's waste acid was delivered to the defendant Jiayu Company for disposal; evidence 5 showed that not all costs of pollution remediation were paid by the plaintiff; and that requiring the defendants to bear lawyer fees lacked legal basis.

The defendant Rixin Company had no objection to the authenticity of the above evidence provided by the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government but argued that the administrative penalty was a punishment for the act of collecting waste acid and was unrelated to the losses arising from pollution remediation, so it should not bear compensatory liability.

In response to the above defendants' opinions on the evidence, the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government argued that most of the costs of pollution remediation were paid by the plaintiff through appropriations, and the survey and design fee of RMB 35,000 was indeed advanced by the Songjiang District Water Affairs Bureau of Shanghai. Since the Songjiang District Water Affairs Bureau of Shanghai was the superior administrative unit of the Songjiang District Ye Xie Water Affairs Management Station, the survey and design at that time were entrusted to relevant units by the Songjiang District Water Affairs Bureau of Shanghai, which paid on behalf of the plaintiff, and subsequently the plaintiff bore the cost and would settle it with the bureau itself. It also submitted a statement (evidence 8) from the Songjiang District Water Affairs Bureau of Shanghai, proving that the survey and design fee of RMB 35,000 was advanced by the bureau and subsequently borne by the plaintiff. Therefore, as the bearer of the losses, the plaintiff could be the plaintiff in this case.

Regarding evidence 8 provided by the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government, the defendants Dong Shengzhen, Jiayu Company, and Rixin Company had no objection; the defendant Haomeng Company had no objection to the authenticity of the evidence but argued that the fee should be claimed separately by the Songjiang District Water Affairs Bureau of Shanghai.

To prove its claims, the defendant Haomeng Company submitted to the court the waste operating license of Shanghai Pudong Jiefang Chemical Plant (a photocopy), proving that the license was provided to Haomeng Company by the defendant Jiayu Company at that time, thereby leading Haomeng Company to believe that Jiayu Company's collection of waste acid was lawful.

The plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government argued regarding the waste operating license of Shanghai Pudong Jiefang Chemical Plant provided by the defendant Haomeng Company that, from its form, the license expired in June 2006 and was no longer legal. It also argued that this evidence proved that the defendant Haomeng Company knew that the defendant Jiayu Company did not have a hazardous waste operating license.

The defendant Dong Shengzhen was unaware of the waste operating license provided by the defendant Haomeng Company.

The defendant Jiayu Company denied having provided the waste operating license of Shanghai Pudong Jiefang Chemical Plant to the defendant Haomeng Company.

The defendant Rixin Company had no objection to the waste operating license provided by the defendant Haomeng Company.

Based on the parties' presentation of evidence and opinions on the evidence, the Songjiang District People's Court of Shanghai certified as follows: As to evidence 1-8 provided by the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government, since all five defendants had no objection to the authenticity of the above evidence, upon examination by the court, the court confirmed the authenticity of the evidence provided by the plaintiff. As to the waste operating license of Shanghai Pudong Jiefang Chemical Plant provided by the defendant Haomeng Company, since the evidence was a photocopy and, from its form, was not within the validity period, and the defendant Jiayu Company also denied having provided the evidence to Haomeng Company, the court found it difficult to confirm the authenticity of the evidence, and moreover, the evidence was not relevant to this case.

The Songjiang District People's Court of Shanghai found:

1. The defendant Jiayu Company had a hydrochloric acid purchase and sale relationship with the defendants Haomeng Company and Rixin Company. At the same time, Haomeng Company and Rixin Company entrusted Jiayu Company to dispose of the waste acid generated after production. Jiayu Company entrusted the defendant Jiang Rongxiang, who had not obtained a hazardous waste operating license, to transport and dispose of waste acid from the above defendant companies. Jiang Rongxiang received a certain amount of fee per ton per truck from the above defendant companies. Between February and March 2011, Jiang Rongxiang repeatedly directed his employed driver, the defendant Dong Shengzhen, to dump one truckload of waste acid collected from Jiayu Company, four truckloads from Haomeng Company, and one truckload from Rixin Company, totaling six truckloads, into the rainwater well located 100 meters south of the Hongxian River Bridge on Yexing Road in Ye Xie Town, causing the waste acid to flow into the Hongxian River through the rainwater well and resulting in serious pollution of the Hongxian River.

2. After the pollution accident, to remediate the pollution, the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government allocated funds and entrusted the Songjiang District Ye Xie Water Affairs Management Station to remediate the polluted river. After the remediation was completed, it entrusted Shanghai Yunjian Construction Engineering Consulting Co., Ltd. to audit the costs of pollution remediation. The audit confirmed that the remediation project cost for the Hongxian River pollution was RMB 714,066, the cost for cleaning polluted sludge from the pipeline was RMB 25,000, the land acquisition and relocation compensation fee was RMB 75,800, the survey and design fee was RMB 35,000, the contract notarization and project quality supervision fee was RMB 27,700, and the audit fee was RMB 9,700, totaling RMB 887,266. Among these, the survey and design fee of RMB 35,000 was advanced by the Songjiang District Water Affairs Bureau of Shanghai, but the bureau made it clear that the fee should be borne by the plaintiff, to which the plaintiff had no objection.

3. Due to this pollution accident, the Shanghai Environmental Protection Bureau imposed an administrative fine of RMB 460,000 on the defendant Jiayu Company, and administrative fines of RMB 160,000 each on the defendants Haomeng Company and Rixin Company.

The issues in dispute in this case were: 1. Whether the plaintiff had proper standing; 2. The liability to be borne by the defendants Jiang Rongxiang and Dong Shengzhen; 3. Whether the defendants Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company should bear corresponding joint and several liability for the losses arising from the pollution accident.

The Songjiang District People's Court of Shanghai held:

1. Regarding the standing of the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government.

According to Article 5, Paragraph 3 of the "Shanghai Municipality River Management Regulations": "Town (township) people's governments and town (township) water conservancy institutions are responsible, within their authority, for the management of rivers under the jurisdiction of towns (townships); ..." Therefore, in this case, the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government, as the competent authority for the polluted town-managed river, has the right to remediate the polluted river and also has the right to file a lawsuit as the plaintiff. Thus, the plaintiff's standing is proper.

2. Regarding the liability to be borne by the defendants Jiang Rongxiang and Dong Shengzhen.

This case is a dispute over tort liability for environmental pollution. During the trial, the defendants Jiang Rongxiang and Dong Shengzhen did not contest their illegal acts and requested the court to handle the civil compensation matter in accordance with the law. Jiang Rongxiang, for profit, without obtaining a hazardous waste operating license, directed his employed driver Dong Shengzhen to dump waste acid into the rainwater well within the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government's territory that flowed into the Hongxian River, causing serious pollution to the Hongxian River. His act was illegal. While he has borne criminal liability, he should also bear civil compensatory liability. Therefore, Jiang Rongxiang shall compensate the plaintiff for the economic losses of RMB 887,266 incurred in remediating the pollution.

Although the defendant Dong Shengzhen was a driver employed by the defendant Jiang Rongxiang, he should have clearly foreseen the potential harmful consequences of dumping untreated waste acid into the rainwater well. However, he failed to timely warn or stop this unlawful act and instead blindly followed Jiang Rongxiang's instructions, intentionally dumping the waste acid into the rainwater well, causing serious pollution to the Hongxian River. Therefore, Dong Shengzhen bears significant fault for the occurrence of the damage and shall bear joint and several liability with his employer Jiang Rongxiang.

3. Regarding the liability to be borne by the defendants Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company.

The waste acid generated during the production processes of the defendants Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company constitutes hazardous waste. When disposing of such hazardous waste, the three companies should have, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Law of the PRC on the Prevention and Control of Environmental Pollution by Solid Waste," reported to the local competent environmental protection authority on the types, quantities, flow, storage, and disposal of the above hazardous waste, and should have, as prescribed by the state, filled out a hazardous waste transfer manifest, obtained approval for the transfer from the competent environmental protection authority with the power of examination and approval, and then delivered the waste to a unit qualified to handle hazardous waste for treatment. However, none of the three companies truthfully reported the specific circumstances of the hazardous waste to the local competent environmental protection authority, nor did they fill out a hazardous waste transfer manifest as prescribed by the state or obtain approval for the transfer from the competent environmental protection authority with the power of examination and approval. They arbitrarily disposed of the waste acid generated during production. Among them, Haomeng Company and Rixin Company, knowing that Jiayu Company did not have the business qualifications to handle hazardous waste, entrusted it with the disposal of waste acid. Jiayu Company, without examining whether the defendant Jiang Rongxiang had the business qualifications to transport, discharge, and handle hazardous waste, arbitrarily entrusted the waste acid from its own company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company to Jiang Rongxiang as an individual for disposal. This act caused the state to lose regulatory control over the hazardous waste generated during the production processes of the three companies. There is a direct causal link between this act and the subsequent act by Jiang Rongxiang directing the defendant Dong Shengzhen to dump untreated waste acid into the rainwater well, causing serious pollution to the Hongxian River. Therefore, Jiayu Company, Haomeng Company, and Rixin Company bear significant fault for this pollution accident and should, in principle, bear joint and several compensatory liability with Jiang Rongxiang. Additionally, taking into account factors such as the quantity of waste acid transported and dumped within the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government's territory from the three companies and the role played by Jiayu Company in this accident, the court determines that Haomeng Company shall bear 65% of the joint and several compensatory liability, Jiayu Company 20%, and Rixin Company 15% for the damage.

As for the plaintiff Ye Xie Town Government's request for the five defendants to bear the lawyer fees, this lacks a legal basis and the court does not support it.

In summary, the Songjiang District People's Court of Shanghai, in accordance with Articles 65, 66, and 67 of the "Tort Law of the PRC," rendered the following judgment on June 28, 2012:

1. The defendant Jiang Rongxiang shall, within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, compensate the plaintiff Songjiang District Ye Xie Town People's Government of Shanghai for various economic losses totaling RMB 887,266;

2. The defendant Dong Shengzhen shall bear joint and several liability for the amount to be compensated by the defendant Jiang Rongxiang as specified in the above judgment;

3. The defendant Shanghai Jiayu Chemical Co., Ltd. shall bear 20% joint and several liability for the amount to be compensated by the defendant Jiang Rongxiang as specified in the first item of the above judgment;

4. The defendant Haomeng Vehicle Parts (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. shall bear 65% joint and several liability for the amount to be compensated by the defendant Jiang Rongxiang as specified in the first item of the above judgment;

5. The defendant Shanghai Rixin Hot-Dip Galvanizing Co., Ltd. shall bear 15% joint and several liability for the amount to be compensated by the defendant Jiang Rongxiang as specified in the first item of the above judgment;

6. The claim of the plaintiff Songjiang District Ye Xie Town People's Government of Shanghai for the five defendants to compensate RMB 74,981 in lawyer fees is dismissed.

After the judgment of first instance, neither party appealed within the statutory period, and the judgment of first instance has become legally effective.
